Container.Name: mealie-ai
Container.Overview:
Mealie self-hosted recipe manager and meal planner: a personal build of upstream Mealie v3.28.0 with this fork's AI additions.
- AI providers are set up in the web UI, per group, under User Settings > Group Settings > AI Provider Settings (not with variables). Any OpenAI-compatible API works: OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or a local Ollama. A default provider is required for AI features; separate image and audio providers are optional. - Create > Import with AI turns photos, pasted text, links or videos into recipes. - Tesseract OCR is built in as a fallback for recipe photos: when no image provider is set, or it fails, the text is read with OCR and the default provider turns it into a recipe. - Recipe cards (in the sidebar) scans stacks of handwritten or printed recipe cards from your phone, an iOS Shortcut, Home Assistant or an optional inbox folder, and lets you check each one before it becomes a recipe.
Upgrading from the older mealie-dev image: back up your appdata folder FIRST. The database is migrated on first start and the old image-scanning variables and admin page no longer exist. Read the deploy guide (Support link) before switching.
On a fresh install, sign in with Mealie's documented default admin account and change its password immediately.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface (the container listens on 9000)

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Database, images, backups and the secret key. When upgrading, point this at a COPY of the old mealie-dev folder.

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: The URL you open Mealie at, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:9925 or https://mealie.example.com. Used for links, emails and the OIDC callback.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone name, e.g. America/New_York. This replaces the server time zone Unraid passes in, so it must not be left empty.

Config.Name: ALLOW_SIGNUP
Config.Description: Allow anyone to register without an invite (true/false)

Config.Name: OCR_ENABLED
Config.Description: Read recipe photos with Tesseract when no image provider is set or it fails. Needs a default AI provider to turn the text into a recipe.

Config.Name: OCR_LANGUAGES
Config.Description: Tesseract language codes joined by +, e.g. eng+deu. This image ships English (eng) only; other languages need a rebuild with OCR_LANGUAGE_PACKS.

Config.Name: OCR_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds before an OCR run is abandoned

Config.Name: Recipe card inbox
Config.Description: Optional. A share outside App Data, e.g. /mnt/user/mealie-inbox. Photos put in its group/household folders are read and queued for review. Mapping the folder turns the inbox on; leave it empty to keep the inbox off.

Config.Name: AI_INGEST_INBOX_DIR
Config.Description: Where the recipe card inbox is in the container: keep /inbox, the folder mapped above. With no folder mapped there the inbox stays off.

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: SMTP server hostname (leave empty to disable email)

Config.Name: SMTP_PORT
Config.Description: SMTP server port

Config.Name: SMTP_AUTH_STRATEGY
Config.Description: TLS, SSL or NONE

Config.Name: SMTP_FROM_EMAIL
Config.Description: From email address

Config.Name: SMTP_USER
Config.Description: SMTP username (set together with SMTP_PASSWORD)

Config.Name: SMTP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: SMTP password

Config.Name: DB_ENGINE
Config.Description: sqlite (stored in App Data) or postgres

Config.Name: POSTGRES_SERVER
Config.Description: PostgreSQL hostname (only used with DB_ENGINE=postgres)

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PORT
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port

Config.Name: POSTGRES_DB
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database name

Config.Name: POSTGRES_USER
Config.Description: PostgreSQL username

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns App Data (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns App Data (Unraid: 100 = users)

Config.Name: UVICORN_WORKERS
Config.Description: Web server worker processes
